name: two-hour-block-hourly-spacing
rationale: Mandatory cost-targeting hypothesis under the warning rule (baseline sharpe_minus_static_mix negative for the ninth consecutive run on 2026-09-25: -8.60 at 50,000 JPY, fee_drag_pct 2.68 vs total_return_pct -0.15). On 2026-09-25 `two-hour-block-two-hour-spacing` (7200/7200) was the best result the pipeline has measured at every capital (50,000 JPY Sharpe 0.008 -> 7.30, fees 1,342 -> 231 JPY; +1.69% at 500,000 JPY) but was rejected solely on trade count (11 / 81 = 14%). 2026-09-22 found that at 50,000 JPY hourly spacing alone RAISED trades (31 -> 40) because longer holds let deltas accumulate past the 0.001 BTC lot floor. This keeps the two-hour signal hold (the component that cuts signal churn) but halves the action spacing to 3600s, testing whether the hold's cost benefit survives with enough rebalances to clear the 50% trade-count bar. Direction at each capital is genuinely uncertain and must be reported per capital; score on total_fees_jpy and the promotion rule, never on trade count.
